name: event-countdowns
title: Event Countdowns
description: Track countdowns to important events like birthdays, anniversaries, and more. Supports one-time, yearly, and monthly recurring events.
author: atsushi_kawamura

commands.name: list-events
commands.title: View Events
commands.subtitle: Event Countdowns
commands.description: View all your countdown events sorted by days remaining

commands.name: archived-events
commands.title: View Archived Events
commands.subtitle: Event Countdowns
commands.description: View past one-time events that have been archived

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
